# MURMUR — Hum to Song

> Turn the hum in your head into a music card you can collect and share.
> Murmur is a web application by [p → q] that transcribes hummed melodies and transforms them into editable, saveable songs.

## What It Is

Murmur is a standalone web app that captures vocal melody input (humming, singing, or whistling), transcribes it with AI, and lets you arrange, save, and share the result as a music card.

## Core Journey

1. **Hum** — Capture a vocal melody at `/`
2. **Vibe** — Review the transcribed melody at `/vibe`
3. **Studio** — Edit and arrange the song at `/studio`
4. **Gallery** — Browse your saved songs at `/gallery`
5. **Share** — Share a song card via public link at `/s/[shareCode]`

## Pages

- [Home](https://murmur.ptoq.io/): Hum capture screen
- [Vibe](https://murmur.ptoq.io/vibe): Transcribed melody review
- [Studio](https://murmur.ptoq.io/studio): Song arrangement and editing
- [Gallery](https://murmur.ptoq.io/gallery): Saved song collection
- [Me](https://murmur.ptoq.io/me): Profile and account settings
- [Top Up](https://murmur.ptoq.io/topup): Purchase additional credits
